title: Moss Garden Table
desc: A table set into a lush moss garden with bright yellow accents.

groups.label: Feature flowers
groups.blurb: Soft whites and pinks rising out of the moss bed.

items.role: White Austin roses in loose clusters across the table — the main bloom.
Pink tulips adding cupped accents between the roses.
Pink ranunculus layered into the mid clusters (yellow ranunculus is a logged gap).
Tiny white daisies sprinkled around the dessert stands.
White baby's breath filling the gaps between blooms.

groups.label: Fruit & fills
groups.blurb: Green grape texture woven through the planting.

items.role: Green-tone grape clusters draped over the moss edge (closest match — bright green grape bunches are a logged note).

groups.label: Foliage & grasses
groups.blurb: The living foliage carrying the garden look.

items.role: Air-plant style wisps sitting on the moss like natural tillandsia.
Cutout monstera leaves giving the bold tropical leaf moments.
Fountain grass plumes adding airy height.
Round eucalyptus sprigs between the flowers.
Asparagus fern softening the arrangement edges (stands in for soft fern texture).
